user_reviews.title: Wonderful
user_reviews.review_text: 5 stars out of 5! To all the people who rated this 1 star, 2 star or 3 due to the excessive 'bass' it has, I suggest you to please use a music player app/software which has equilizer in it. I am writing this after testing the speakers for atleast 10 hours. These speakers have tremendous potential. It has the best in class amplifier and thus sound. The user just have to set it up properly. Use an equilizer and adjust the bass, mids and highs. It takes 1 minute to do so. After this, you will hear the true beauty it can deliver. I am amazed by the sound in terms of clarity, treble and bass! Don't think it will work the best just out of the box, give it some time, understand it and adjust your sound prefrences via your music player app or software.
